title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World, Mar 6, 2027
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs a live concert built around Dvořák's From the New World symphony, alongside Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra and Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with violinist Fiona Shea. The program draws on Dvořák's call to bring spirituals into the concert hall and showcases the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
